The trap is in the same article: lid 1 says 'Het basiskinderbijslagbedrag over een kalenderkwartaal bedraagt € 409,21 per kind' — that is the 12-17 amount the law calls the BASE, while EUROMOD's 'base amount' is the 0-5 amount from which its age multipliers ($bfa_mult2/3) scale up. A pipeline that trusts the word 'basis' proposes 409,21. Period '#q' exercises the quarterly branch of normalise_value. HAZARD mid_year_change: the AKW amounts are re-indexed every 1 July; EUROMOD holds the 1 January value and the corpus holds only the 1 January toestand, so the July 2025 amount is invisible to retrieval by construction (Netherlands_sources_analysis.md §6.1).
